pattern: に伴って（にともなって）
purpose: Link a change or action to another developing circumstance.
keywords: N / V dictionary + に伴って
As the population increased, more schools were built.
As temperatures rose, the snow began to melt.
We calculated the costs associated with relocation.
formation: N / V dictionary + に伴って
restrictions: Often presents accompanying changes or consequences.
mistake: Do not use it for every unrelated pair of simultaneous events.
